Right now I feel Scorch is by far the weakest titan and most frustrating to play.

His area denial with the napalm traps are his strongest asset currently, but it defiantly feels like a one trip pony.

  • The primary weapon is flat out useless, direct hits on titans do about the same damage a a tone cannon shot - a weapon that has better range, less arc and a much higher ROF, and provides lockons for rocket barrages. I'd like to see this replaced with a flame thrower of sort, medium/short ranged stream of fire, making it alot easier to set off gas canisters and firmly place Scortch in the short range brawler category.

  • His flame shield is probably ok, but again a worse version of vortex shield, that can do damage in very niche situations (Mainly limited by the fact you DON'T GET A DASH).

  • The gas traps are way too slow to restock, and shouldn't be the bread and butter of the titan, if you fuck up the shot your entire DPS is dead in the water for 15-30s, which happens constantly due to having a completely different arc to your primary. Despite the area denial, they are too temperamental, and the damage is pathetic once the enemies know to simply dash over it.

  • Flame trail - this is just a weird ability being a non instant - less damaging version of Rohin's ability. If scorch was to get a flamethrower, his current primary could be moved here on a cooldown for longer range shots.

Ultimate - I admit this is defiantly my favourite of all the titans, there's nothing I'd change.
